name: kattakath-workspace
description: Google Workspace in Claude through ONE connector, 'Kattakath Workspace' (a Cloudflare MCP portal at mcp.kattakath.com holding Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat, People, Maps, Tasks, Forms, Contacts and a cross-app Workspace search; the same tools on web, phone and Claude Code): a routing skill, a fail-closed write guard that asks before risky writes (deletes, batch contact changes, publishing a form, restoring trash or spam, system labels), and a gated cross-app locator. Read-mostly by design: Gmail drafts (the user sends), no Chat posts, no edits, no sharing or trash; Tasks, Forms and Contacts are read and write. Ships the connector itself.

locator_mode.title: Cross-app search (search_corpus)
locator_mode.description: ask: confirm before each cross-app Workspace search (default). auto: run it without asking. off: refuse it; the per-app searches still work.
